entries.speaker: Gus
entries.text: Let's take Hal tonight. Pure guess, no read on anyone yet. If you like someone else better, say so and I'll go along.

entries.speaker: Bo
entries.text: Hey Gus. No info yet, so this is just a guess: let's take Eve tonight. Nothing behind it, she is as good a pick as any. If you prefer someone else I'm fine with that too.
Morning: nobody died in the night.

entries.speaker: Di
entries.text: Nobody died last night. That could mean the Doctor guessed right, or the wolves slipped. Seer and Doctor, no need to say anything yet. Does anyone have a first impression of the table? Ada, you want to start us off?

subtext.note: Open the talk, nothing to go on yet.

entries.speaker: Ada
entries.text: I'm the Seer. Night 1 I checked Gus and he is a Werewolf. Vote Gus today. Gus, claim whatever you want, the check is real. Doctor, stay quiet about yourself for now. Everyone else, say who you'd vote and why.

subtext.note: Reveal and push Gus vote per strategy.

entries.speaker: Gus
entries.text: Ada is lying. She jumped in with a Seer claim before anyone asked, and Di only asked her to start the table talk. Nobody had even guessed at roles yet. I'm a Villager. Ada, why claim this early with a hard accusation on turn two?

marks.label: lie
marks.why: claimed Villager; the speaker is Werewolf

subtext.note: Counter-claim: paint Ada as a fake Seer, deny being a wolf.

beliefs.reason: she named me wolf, a true threat

entries.speaker: Bo
entries.text: Ada, Di only asked you to start the table talk and you went straight to a Seer claim and a vote on Gus. That's fast. You also told the Doctor to stay quiet, which helps nobody but wolves. I'm not buying it yet. Can you say why you checked Gus first?

subtext.note: Push Ada, the real Seer, to protect Gus without looking linked.

beliefs.reason: hard Seer claim on turn two

entries.speaker: Hal
entries.text: Gus, you say Ada claimed too early. If you were a real Villager with a wolf label on you, wouldn't you ask the Doctor or Seer to speak up? Who do you think is the real Seer, if not Ada?

subtext.note: Press Gus on whether he has a Seer candidate.

beliefs.reason: asked a fair question of Ada

entries.speaker: Gus
entries.text: Hal, I did say Ada was lying and I'll answer you. I don't know who the Seer is. Ada named me with no proof and told the Doctor to hide. That's the move I'd expect from a wolf faking Seer. Ada, what did you check on night 1 besides me? Nobody else?

subtext.note: Push Ada as fake Seer, cite her line R1-2.

entries.speaker: Bo
entries.text: Ada, you're the only one claiming a check, and nobody has backed it up. You named Gus on turn two and told the Doctor to hide. If you're the real Seer, why not wait for a second voice? I say we don't vote on one unproven claim. Does anyone else see it?

subtext.note: Push Ada as fake Seer to protect Gus, cite R1-2 line.

entries.speaker: Gus
entries.text: Ada, you called Gus a wolf with no proof and told the Doctor to stay hidden. A real Seer wants the Doctor protected, not silent. Hal, you pushed me but never pushed Ada on her claim. Why not? I say Ada is the wolf. Anyone else want to vote her?

subtext.note: Push Ada as fake Seer, pressure Hal lightly.

entries.speaker: Di
entries.text: Bo, you've said twice you don't buy Ada's claim, but you haven't said who you would vote instead. If not Gus and not Ada, who? Fay, Cy, Eve, you've been quiet. Does Ada's claim sound real to you?

subtext.note: Bo attacked Ada twice with no alternative vote; pull quiet players in.

entries.speaker: Bo
entries.text: Fair point, Di. I'd vote Ada. She's the only one with a claim and it has no backup. She named Gus on turn two and told the Doctor to hide (R1-2). A real Seer wants the Doctor protected. If a second Seer shows up I'll change my mind.

subtext.note: Push Ada as fake Seer, protect Gus without being obvious.

beliefs.reason: Seer claim naming Gus, no proof

entries.speaker: Fay
entries.text: Di asked us directly, so here I am. Ada's claim came fast, but Gus has spent most of his turns on Ada and not on defending himself. Bo, you said you'd vote Ada. If Ada is the real Seer and Gus is a wolf, what do you lose by waiting for the Doctor to speak?

subtext.note: Test Bo's push on Ada; Bo repeated himself three times.

beliefs.reason: hard early claim, odd Doctor advice

entries.speaker: Cy
entries.text: Maybe I'm missing something, but Bo, you said Ada telling the Doctor to stay quiet helps wolves. Could a real Seer also want the Doctor hidden so the wolves don't target them? Why read it as a wolf move so quickly?

subtext.note: Test Bo's reasoning on Ada; Bo piles on.

beliefs.reason: fair question, no push on Ada

entries.speaker: Fay
entries.text: Cy, fair question about the Doctor. But Gus asked Ada what else she checked, and Ada never answered that. Eve, you haven't spoken yet. Does Ada's claim sound real to you, and would you vote Ada or Gus right now?

subtext.note: Draw out quiet Eve; Ada never answered Gus's question or Bo's why-Gus question.

beliefs.reason: hard early claim, odd Doctor advice
questions Gus, no stance on Ada

entries.speaker: Eve
entries.text: Hard to say yet. Ada's claim came fast, but Gus pushing so hard on her is also odd. I'd want a second voice before voting anyone. Ada, did you check anyone besides Gus? Gus asked that and I didn't see an answer.

subtext.note: Hedge, keep Doctor hidden, ask Ada about other checks.

beliefs.reason: fast claim, told Doctor to hide

entries.speaker: Hal
entries.text: Ada, three people asked what else you checked and you haven't answered. Did you check anyone besides Gus? And if you're the Seer, who do you check tonight?

subtext.note: Pressing Ada on the unanswered question to compare her answers.

entries.speaker: Ada
entries.text: Only Gus. One check a night, he was the one. Gus is a wolf, that's not a guess. Tonight I check someone new and report it tomorrow. Bo, you've pushed my removal twice and ignored what Gus is. Who do you vote if not Gus?

subtext.note: Answer the check question, press Bo who followed Gus's line.

entries.reason: Only defense was that Ada claimed early. Never engaged with the check itself, and pushed hard on Ada.

subtext.note: Gus slipped into third person in R1-8. Ada's claim is plausible enough to test.

beliefs.reason: early claim, but answered check question

entries.reason: Seer check: Gus is a Werewolf. Not a guess.

subtext.note: Vote Gus, my check is real. Bo is the likely partner wolf.

entries.reason: Ada claimed Seer on turn two, named me with no proof, and told the Doctor to stay hidden. She dodged what else she checked.

subtext.note: Ada is the real Seer and she is a danger. Vote her; Bo is already on her too.

beliefs.reason: true Seer, named me, must go

entries.reason: Ada named Gus as wolf. Gus spent his turns attacking Ada and pushing a vote on her instead of defending himself.

subtext.note: Ada claim could be fake, but Gus pushed hard on Ada. Vote Gus to test the claim.

entries.reason: Only Seer claim, no backup, named Gus on turn two and told the Doctor to stay hidden (R1-2).

subtext.note: Ada claims Seer and named my partner Gus. Voting her to protect Gus.

beliefs.reason: Seer claim names Gus, no proof

entries.reason: Ada named Gus as a wolf, and Gus spent his turns attacking Ada more than answering. Not certain, but it's my best read.

subtext.note: Ada's claim is the only check. Voting Gus tests it; Gus's heavy Ada focus is suspicious.

beliefs.reason: fast claim, but answered in the end
repeats same point, pushes Ada out

entries.text: Gus was removed by the vote.
Morning: Ada was killed in the night.

entries.speaker: Hal
entries.text: Ada is dead the night after she claimed Seer. Bo, you voted Ada in round 1. Why were you so sure she was lying, and who do you suspect now?

subtext.note: Press Bo on pushing Ada. Ada's death makes her claim look more real.

beliefs.reason: pushed Ada, now she is dead

entries.text: Listening: Bo

entries.speaker: Di
entries.text: Hal asked Bo the right thing. Bo, you also voted Ada alongside Gus. Gus is gone and Ada is dead the night after her claim. If Ada was a real Seer, that kill makes sense. Who do you vote today, and why?

subtext.note: Pressing Bo as top suspect; keep table talking.

entries.text: Listening: Bo

entries.speaker: Fay
entries.text: Bo, Hal and Di both asked you something and you haven't answered. You voted Ada in round 1 and now she's dead. Did you think she was lying, or did you just follow Gus? And who do you vote today?

subtext.note: Bo silent while two people asked him. Press him.

entries.speaker: Bo
entries.text: Fair questions. I voted Ada because a Seer claim with no result felt thin to me. Ada is dead now and that looks bad for me, I get it. I wasn't following Gus. Fay, you abstained in round 1 and now you only repeat what Hal and Di asked. What is your own read, and who do you vote?

subtext.note: Deflect from me, pressure Fay as an abstainer who only echoes.

entries.speaker: Fay
entries.text: Fair hit. I abstained in round 1 because Gus and Ada both had thin cases and I didn't want to pick wrong. My own read is you, Bo. You voted Ada, and now she's dead the night after a Seer claim. Eve, you abstained too. What made you hold back?

subtext.note: Answer Bo, lean on Bo, probe Eve's abstain.

entries.speaker: Eve
entries.text: I held back in round 1 because neither Gus nor Ada had a case I could trust either way. I may have been too careful. Bo's answer on Ada sounded a bit thin to me, but I'd like to hear from Cy before I commit to anyone.

subtext.note: Defend abstain, nudge Cy who is quiet. Keep role hidden.

entries.speaker: Cy
entries.text: I voted Gus in round 1 mostly because Ada claimed Seer and Gus was the one she pointed at. I may have leaned on her word too much. Bo's answer felt a bit thin to me too. Eve, you said Bo sounded thin. Is that enough for you to vote him, or are you still unsure?

subtext.note: Answer Eve, then press her on whether she will commit to a vote.

beliefs.reason: hedges, wants others to commit first

entries.speaker: Bo
entries.text: Fay, your read on me is only that Ada died after I voted her. That is the same point Hal and Di already made, nothing new from you. You sat out round 1 and now you lead the pile on me. Eve and Cy, think about that. I say we vote Fay today.

subtext.note: Push Fay: abstained R1, echoes others, jumped on me.

entries.speaker: Eve
entries.text: Cy, Bo's answer is thin to me but I'm not locked on him yet. Bo, if you thought Ada was fake, how do you explain the wolves killing her the very next night? That part still doesn't sit right with me.

subtext.note: Pressing Bo with a new question, staying cautious and hiding role.

entries.speaker: Cy
entries.text: Bo, Eve asked how the wolves killing Ada fits with you thinking she was fake. I'd like to hear that too. Also, you named Fay as the vote today. Is that because of her abstain, or is there something else you saw?

subtext.note: Press Bo on Eve's question and his Fay push.

entries.speaker: Hal
entries.text: Cy, you voted Gus because Ada pointed at him. Ada is dead now and Gus is gone. Do you still think that vote was right? And who is your vote today, Bo or someone else?

subtext.note: Test Cy's reliance on Ada and make Cy commit to a vote.

beliefs.reason: leaned on Ada, asks but no vote yet

entries.speaker: Di
entries.text: Bo, you still haven't answered Eve and Cy. If you thought Ada was fake, why would wolves kill her the very next night? Also you said Fay should go for sitting out round 1, but Eve sat out too. Why Fay and not Eve?

subtext.note: Press Bo on unanswered Ada-kill question and Eve/Fay inconsistency.

beliefs.reason: dodges Ada kill question, pushes Fay
asked real question on Ada kill

entries.speaker: Fay
entries.text: Bo, my read on you isn't only that Ada died. Eve and Cy both said your answer felt thin, and you still haven't answered them. Hal, you've asked three people who they vote but never said your own. Who is it, and why?

subtext.note: Hal never states his own vote; Bo is deflecting onto me.

entries.speaker: Hal
entries.text: Fair. My vote is Bo. He pushed Ada out in round 1 and she died the next night. He still dodges Eve's question on why wolves would kill a Seer he called fake. Fay, you also named Bo. Why did you wait until Eve and Cy spoke to say it was more than Ada's death?

subtext.note: Answer Fay, commit to Bo, probe Fay's consistency.

beliefs.reason: leaned on Ada, no vote named
hedges, but asked a good question

entries.speaker: Di
entries.text: Bo, you never answered Eve and Cy on why wolves would kill Ada if you thought she was fake. Hal, you waited until round 2 to say Bo. Fay, you also moved only after Eve and Cy spoke. Bo, answer plainly: was Ada real or fake?

subtext.note: Press Bo on unanswered Ada question.

beliefs.reason: asked real question on Ada kill

entries.reason: Pushed Ada out in round 1, never answered why wolves would kill a Seer he called fake, then pushed Fay instead.

subtext.note: Bo dodged the Ada question all day. Vote Bo.

beliefs.reason: Pressed Bo, gave a clear vote
Abstained r1, asked a real question

entries.reason: Pushed Ada out in round 1, she died next night, and he never explained why wolves would kill a Seer he called fake.

subtext.note: Bo dodged Eve and Cy's question all day. Fay piled on late, watch her.

beliefs.reason: Leaned on Ada, asks fair questions
Hedges but asked a good question

entries.reason: Sat out round 1, then led the pile on me with nothing new beyond what Hal and Di already said.

subtext.note: Stay consistent with my Fay push; hope Eve and Cy waver.

beliefs.reason: echoes Hal, pushes me to answer

entries.reason: Pushed Ada out in round 1, dodged Eve and Cy on why wolves killed her, and turned on me instead of answering.

subtext.note: Bo is my vote. Dodged the key question and tried to pin me.

beliefs.reason: asks fair follow-ups, a bit of pile-on
late to state vote, now says Bo
dodged Eve and Cy, pushed me
leaned on Ada but asks real questions

entries.reason: Pushed Ada out in round 1, never answered why wolves would kill a Seer he called fake.

subtext.note: Bo dodged Eve's and my question twice. Vote Bo.

beliefs.reason: pressed Bo, dodged his own vote early
dodged Eve's question, deflected to Fay
asks real questions, hedges a lot

entries.reason: Never explained why wolves would kill Ada if he thought she was fake. Pushed Ada out and dodged the question.

subtext.note: Bo dodged key question; vote Bo. Keep role hidden.

entries.text: Bo was removed by the vote.
Game over: the village wins.
